question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the permanent contract changes model-visible context, channel ownership, plugin SDK expectations, retry semantics, and diagnostics; automation cannot safely choose that product/API shape.

options.title: Shared typed delivery contract
options.body: Reuse durable outbound outcomes and define one cross-channel agent/tool-visible failure contract before adding model-visible behavior.

options.title: Tool and caller status only
options.body: Limit the work to structured delivery status in message/agent tool results and avoid injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep narrow channel paths
options.body: Leave CLI, cron, restart recovery, and channel-specific handling as the supported behavior and defer or close the shared model-visible request.

recommendation.title: Shared typed delivery contract
recommendation.body: Reuse durable outbound outcomes and define one cross-channel agent/tool-visible failure contract before adding model-visible behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the shared outbound/channel delivery boundary and product-facing agent behavior where steipete has the strongest feature-history signal.
